items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Glenn Miller, he said, yeah, I'm over there, not the blue room, you know.

ctx.x: Well, wait a minute. This is before, way back. I'm going to go back when. Coming around there, Mr. Quaglina, had Philip, trombones playing. Joe played saxophone, and he played trombones. Years later, it was the little parody, man. You're talking about. But now, I come around there. And boy, they knew that Joe was the top saxophone player. Joe had a beautiful tone. See, Joe played violin for us. He knew music back, but he played saxophone from Warren Ries in high school, who played saxophone. Every day, he…
You never tell him about Snoozy?
